autoscaling-policy-designer 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Introduces a skill for designing autoscaling policies optimized for performance, cost, and reliability.
- Guides users through analyzing historical metrics and classifying traffic patterns.
- Provides step-by-step commands for collecting utilization data from Kubernetes (Prometheus) and AWS (CloudWatch).
- Offers scripts for identifying traffic types (steady, spiky, daily/weekly cycles) and their scaling implications.
- Includes example report templates and concrete policy generation for Kubernetes HPA and cloud autoscalers.
- Designed to help right-size workloads, handle traffic spikes, and model scaling costs effectively.
